scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: New series on Radio Aurora: secret hobbies! Did you know our maths teacher collects tiny spoons?

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the hobby words.

words.clue: A board game with kings, queens and horses.
Books with pictures and speech bubbles.
You put many small pieces together to make a picture.
Making pictures with colours and a brush.

activities.title: Match the person with their hobby.
Listen to the secret hobbies report. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Diego: Secret hobbies, episode one! First: our maths teacher collects tiny spoons. He has got ninety-two! … Oliver: Ninety-two spoons! Where does he keep them? … Diego: On three shelves in his kitchen. Next: the school cook loves photography. … Diego: She takes photos of clouds every morning before work. … Oliver: Beautiful! And what about you, Diego? … Diego: Me? I collect old radios. My grandpa gave me the first one. … Oliver: And my secret hobby is… cooking! I make excellent banana pancakes. … Diego: Tomorrow: does the head teacher really dance tango? Don't miss it!

questions.q: The maths teacher has got … tiny spoons.
The cook takes photos of … every morning.

data.text: Hobby detective: ask yes/no questions to discover your partner's favourite hobby: "Do you do it inside? Do you need music?" Maximum 8 questions!

activities.title: Look at A and B. What is different?
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 11 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Write about your hobby: what it is, when you do it, why you love it, and one thing you have made/won/collected. 4-5 sentences.

outcomes.puede: Understand dialogues and short stories (Flyers parts 1–5); infer mood from intonation.
Narrate stories with past/present/future; express preferences with reasons.
Read and understand short stories (80–250 words); find main idea and detail.
Writing Part 3: 20–25-word picture story (Flyers); classroom pieces 100–150w.
~2500 words (Flyers wordlist); Present perfect intro, tag Qs, 0th conditional, be going to.
